transform_src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color == bg:
                    continue
                pr, pc = r - dr, c - dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue
                run = []
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    run.append((rr, cc))
                    rr, cc = rr + dr, cc + dc
                if len(run) < 2:
                    continue
                for sr, sc, step_r, step_c in ((r-dr, c-dc, -dr, -dc), (rr, cc, dr, dc)):
                    cells = []
                    while 0 <= sr < h and 0 <= sc < w and out[sr][sc] == bg:
                        cells.append((sr, sc))
                        sr, sc = sr + step_r, sc + step_c
                    if len(cells) >= 2:
                        for ar, ac in cells:
                            out[ar][ac] = color
    return out
'''
exec(transform_src)

    for r,c,v in pts:g[r][c]=v
